testcase.name: a draft of a file that was never stored has no base
a kept version comes back exactly as it was kept, and drafts and kept versions do not mix
putting a draft for the same path replaces it
a truncated draft is skipped, the others are read
remove forgets one draft and is quiet about a missing one
files that are not drafts are ignored
text that looks like the header is still text
a draft comes back exactly as it was put
the draft of a save that has begun says so, and an older draft without the mark is no such draft
a path with a line break or a backslash survives
a draft is on disk when put returns, with no temporary file left
a store whose directory does not exist yet has no drafts
